capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Extended-range pack 92 kWh gross (EVspecs.org). Conflict: EVKX 94 kWh, repo/EV Database 90 kWh; EVspecs.org lists an impossible Plus Extended usable 97.7 > 92 gross, so it is a weak source.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: VinFast US MY27 spec sheet: 87.7 kWh usable on Eco and Plus. Earlier years assumed the same pack (an 82 kWh standard-range pack also existed per EVspecs/Wikipedia; no North American VinFast page shows it). Verified only for MY2027 (VinFast US sheet); years 2023-2026 compared via CleanTechnica (2024 article: 87.7 kWh Eco and Plus) and EVspecs; the repo note says the first 2023 City Edition cars had an 82 kWh pack, not confirmed either way.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: VinFast US charging page describes only app cabin pre-heat/pre-cool; the MY27 VF 9 spec sheet lists a High Voltage Battery Heater (automatic, not a user feature). No battery-preconditioning-for-charging feature found in VinFast US pages. Owner manual not found. No owner's manual or maker statement found; owner decision requested.

chemistry.notes: "The VF 8 Eco and Plus are equipped with an 87.7 kWh CATL NMC battery" (CleanTechnica).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists a 400 V architecture for the VF 8 Plus (search excerpt; page returned 429 when opened), EVKX (blocked) a 403 V nominal; no page opened states the voltage.

dc_max_kw.notes: 150 kW DC (EVspecs.org); VinFast states 10-70 % in 31 min. VinFast US sheet gives only 10-70 % in 31 min; EVspecs.org labels 150 kW "DC Fast Charging", not "max".
